help.emergency.p1.message: If your settings turn out to be too strict, the emergency exit always works and needs nobody else: request it, wait ({hours} hours by default), then type a sentence.

help.emergency.p2.message: It ends all sessions, sets every protection level to Soft and removes the password. Your rules stay as they are. The exit is recorded.

help.faq.uninstall.q.message: Can WebHandbrake prevent its own uninstallation?

help.focus.p1.message: A focus session blocks the sites of the chosen rules, or every site except a short list, for a while. Start one in two taps from the popup, or with Alt+Shift+F.

help.focus.p2.message: Extending a session is always possible. Ending it early follows your protection level; sessions marked "cannot be interrupted" can only end early through the emergency exit.

help.groups.p1.message: Add sites by typing or pasting addresses; whole lists work too. A domain always includes its subdomains. You can be more precise with paths, single pages, the home page only, wildcards, query parameters and, in advanced mode, regular expressions.

help.groups.p2.message: Exceptions ("+") allow parts of a blocked site. The most specific entry wins: with reddit.com blocked and +reddit.com/r/*/comments/* allowed, single discussions open while the rest of Reddit stays blocked. When an exception and a block are equally specific, the block wins. Exceptions only apply to their own rule.

help.groups.p3.message: Shared lists let several rules reuse the same sites, and "Always allowed" lists sites that are never restricted, whatever the rules and sessions say.

help.interventions.p1.message: From the gentlest to the strictest: only count time, show a reminder, apply a filter (grayscale, blur…), ask what you want to do and for how long, make you wait, ask you to type a short challenge, block the page, close the tab or redirect elsewhere.

help.interventions.p2.message: On every intervention page the healthy choice comes first: close the tab or go back. You can save the page for later and find it in "Later" when it is allowed again.

help.interventions.p3.message: If a restriction starts while you are typing in a page, you get a short grace period to finish or copy your text before the page is replaced.

help.issue.message: Report a problem or suggest an idea

help.issueHelp.message: On GitHub. A diagnostic report (Settings → Diagnostics) helps to find the cause.

help.license.message: Licensed under the GNU General Public License v3.0 or later.

help.mobile.p1.message: Everything essential works on Firefox for Android. Open the popup from the Extensions menu and the dashboard from the add-on settings.

help.mobile.p2.message: Keyboard shortcuts and the context menu do not exist on Android. Time is counted only while Firefox is in the foreground and the page is visible.

help.pauses.p1.message: A break suspends the interventions of a page, a site, a rule or all rules for a few minutes. Each rule decides whether breaks are allowed, how long they last, how many you can take and what they cost (a confirmation, a wait, a typed challenge or your password).

help.pauses.p2.message: Breaks end by themselves and the restriction comes back immediately on every open tab. You can end a break early at any time.

help.privacy.p1.message: WebHandbrake has no account, no server and no telemetry. It makes no network requests. Your settings and statistics stay in your browser profile.

help.privacy.p2.message: Statistics are daily totals per site and per rule; full addresses are never stored, and no site detail is kept for private windows. You can export or delete everything at any time.

help.protection.p1.message: Making your rules stricter is always immediate. Loosening them (removing a site, raising a limit, turning a rule off…) depends on the protection level of the rule or of the whole extension.

help.protection.p2.message: Soft asks for a confirmation. Balanced makes you wait a little. Strict puts the change in a queue for a cooling-off period ({hours} hours by default): after the wait you confirm it with a short challenge, or it expires; while a strict rule is active, it cannot be loosened at all. Locked refuses every loosening until a date you choose.

help.protection.p3.message: Pending changes are listed in Protection, where you can confirm or cancel them. A password and random codes can be added for every change that is not a strengthening.

help.protection.p4.message: The protection centre also checks the known ways around a blocker (private windows, browser settings pages, the system clock…) and records signs of tampering.

help.rules.p1.message: Each rule has one or more conditions with what happens, such as "Mon–Fri 09:00–17:00 → Block" or "Always, after 45 min per day → Wait 30 s". Conditions are checked from top to bottom and the first true one applies. If none applies, time is only counted.

help.rules.p2.message: A condition can use time windows (also overnight, like 22:00–02:00), and optionally a limit: time per hour, day, week, month or custom period, visits per period, or continuous use followed by a mandatory stop.

help.rules.p3.message: Time is counted only while the page is visible, the window has the focus and you are active (or a video is playing). Several tabs of the same rule never count twice. A visit starts when you come back after a few minutes away ({minutes} by default).

help.rules.p4.message: When several rules apply to the same site, the strictest result wins, whatever their order. "Test a URL" in the rule editor and "Why?" in the popup show exactly which condition applies and when it will change.

help.shortcutsNote.message: Shortcuts can be changed in the browser's extension shortcut settings. They are not available on Android.

help.start.p1.message: WebHandbrake is a handbrake for the web: it helps you use the sites you choose when and as much as you decided, with as little friction as needed. Everything stays on this device.

help.start.p2.message: You organise sites in rules (for example Social or Video). Each rule says when and how it slows you down: a reminder, a filter, a question, a wait, a short challenge or a block.

help.start.p3.message: The popup shows what applies to the current site and offers quick actions: start a focus session, block the site, save the page for later, take a break. The dashboard (this page) is where you manage everything.

save.pendingBody.message: This change loosens your rules: it can be confirmed in {wait}, from {when}. Until then nothing changes, and you can cancel it in Protection.

save.refused.accessWindow.message: Settings cannot be loosened at this time of day.

save.refused.locked.message: These rules are locked: nothing that loosens them is possible now.

save.refused.lockedNow.message: This rule is active and strictly protected: loosening it is possible only when it is not active.

save.refused.lockedUntil.message: These rules are locked until {until}: nothing that loosens them is possible before then.

save.refusedHelp.message: Making rules stricter is always possible. If you are truly stuck, the emergency exit in Protection always works.

schedule.gridHelp.message: Click or drag on the grid to add time; drag over coloured cells to remove it. The fields above are more precise.

schedule.overnight.message: Runs past midnight: it belongs to the day it starts.

session.error.locked.message: This session cannot be interrupted. Only the emergency exit can end it early.

session.error.strict.message: With your protection level, a running focus session cannot be ended early. You can still extend it.

setting.sound.message: Sound at the end of breaks

settings.advancedHelp.message: Shows regular expressions, rolling windows, per-site limits, text editing of lists and other expert options.

settings.allSitesHelp.message: Off by default: only the sites of your rules are measured. Data stays on this device.

settings.alternativesHelp.message: Suggestions shown on intervention pages. With an address they become buttons (for example Anki or your to-do list).

settings.autoReopen.message: Reopen pages automatically when they become available

settings.badge.enabled.message: Show the remaining time on the toolbar icon

settings.contextMenuHelp.message: "Block this site" and "Start a focus session" in the right-click menu (desktop only).

settings.countAudioHelp.message: Also count tabs playing media in the background or in picture-in-picture.

settings.countInactive.message: Count tabs that are open but not active

settings.countInactiveHelp.message: Stricter: time counts as long as a page of the rule is open in any tab.

settings.customCssHelp.message: CSS applied to the intervention pages. External resources (url(), @import) are removed.

settings.dateHeadersHelp.message: Compares your clock with the date of web pages you already load. No extra requests are made and nothing is stored.

settings.dayStartHelp.message: For night owls: with 04:00, the hours after midnight still count as the previous day for windows and daily limits.

settings.globalBreaksHelp.message: A shared limit on top of the limits of each rule.

settings.graceHelp.message: If a restriction starts while you are writing, you get these seconds to finish or copy your text (0 to turn it off).

settings.hideUrl.message: Hide the address of blocked pages

settings.hideUrlHelp.message: Shows only the rule's name, so you are not tempted to copy the link.

settings.idle.message: Stop counting when I am inactive

settings.idleHelp.message: Without keyboard, mouse or touch input for a while, time is not counted (except while a video plays).

settings.languageHelp.message: More languages will come from the community. The page reloads after a change.

settings.notificationsHelp.message: Optional. The browser asks for permission when you turn them on.

settings.retentionHelp.message: Older days are deleted automatically (totals needed by time limits are kept for up to 90 days).

settings.shortcuts.message: Keyboard shortcuts: Alt+Shift+H (popup), Alt+Shift+F (focus session), Alt+Shift+B (block the site). Change them in the browser's extension shortcut settings.

settings.sound.message: Sound at the end of a break

settings.soundHelp.message: A soft chime. Off by default.

settings.timer.enabled.message: Show a timer on limited sites

settings.timer.help.message: A small, movable countdown appears when little time is left before a restriction.

settings.trackingHelp.message: Time is counted only when a page of a rule is visible, its window has the focus and you are active.

settings.visitGapHelp.message: Minutes away from a rule's sites after which coming back counts as a new visit.

settings.warningSecondsHelp.message: A short message on the page (0 to turn it off).

status.site.exempt.message: WebHandbrake does not act on this page

status.site.visitsLeft.message: {count, plural, =0 {No visits left} one {# visit left} other {# visits left}}

summary.noPolicies.message: No conditions yet: time is only counted.

tamper.clock-backward.message: The system clock was moved back by about {detail} min. Time used by WebHandbrake never goes backwards.

tamper.clock-skew.message: The system clock differs from web servers by about {detail} min. WebHandbrake uses the corrected time.

tamper.emergency.message: Emergency exit: {detail, select, requested {requested} cancelled {cancelled} completed {completed} other {{detail}}}.

tamper.host-permission.message: Access to all sites was removed.

tamper.inactive-gap.message: WebHandbrake was not running for about {detail} min while the browser was open (disabled or crashed).

tamper.private-access.message: Access to private windows was removed.

tamper.rules-mismatch.message: The browser's blocking filters did not match the settings and were rebuilt.

tamper.state-restored.message: The settings were damaged and were restored from a backup.

targets.addPlaceholder.message: Add a site, or paste a list…

targets.error.noDot.message: Not a site address: add the ending, for example youtube.com.

targets.error.regexBackref.message: Back-references are not allowed in patterns.

targets.error.regexInvalid.message: This regular expression is not valid.

targets.error.regexLookaround.message: Look-ahead and look-behind are not allowed in patterns.

targets.error.regexNested.message: Nested repetitions like (a+)+ can freeze the browser and are not allowed.

targets.error.scheme.message: Only web pages, local files and browser pages can be added.

targets.error.tooBroad.message: This would match every site. Use a focus session with allowed sites instead.

targets.errors.message: {count, plural, one {# line was not added:} other {# lines were not added:}}

targets.exceptionsHelp.message: Parts of these sites that stay allowed. The most specific entry wins.

targets.guide.countries.message: The same site in every country: amazon.com, amazon.it, amazon.co.uk…

targets.guide.exception.message: An exception: + at the start keeps this part allowed while the rest of the site is not.

targets.guide.homepage.message: Only the home page, for example the feed: videos opened from a link still work.

targets.guide.host.message: Only this exact address, without its subdomains.

targets.guide.page.message: A single page: the $ at the end leaves out the pages under it.

targets.guide.paste.message: Pasting a list? One address per line. Full links work too, and lists from other blockers or hosts files are converted.

targets.guide.section.message: One section and everything under it.

targets.guide.site.message: A whole site, with all its pages and subdomains (m.youtube.com, music.youtube.com…).

targets.guide.subdomain.message: Only one part of a site: the rest of youtube.com stays as it is.

targets.guide.wildcard.message: * stands for any text within one part of the address: here, the comments of every community.

targets.hidden.message: {count, plural, one {# address from a sensitive list is hidden} other {# addresses from sensitive lists are hidden}}

targets.textHelp.message: One entry per line. "+" for exceptions, "#" for comments. See Help for the full syntax.

ticket.confirm.body.message: Do you really want to go ahead?

ticket.error.expired.message: This request has expired. Please start again.

ticket.error.failed.message: Something went wrong. Please try again.

ticket.error.intentionRequired.message: Please say in a few words what you want to do.

ticket.error.notYet.message: Not yet — the wait is not over.

ticket.error.tooMany.message: Too many attempts. Try again in a few seconds.

ticket.error.wrongAnswer.message: That is not the right answer.

ticket.intention.body.message: Say what you want to do and for how long.

ticket.text.accessible.message: I use a screen reader: type a sentence instead

ticket.wait.body.message: Wait {seconds} seconds. Use the time to ask yourself if you really want this.

warning.dnr-error.short.message: Blocking could not be set up for some sites.

warning.dnr-overflow.message: {detail} entries are enforced without browser filters: pages may appear briefly before being blocked.

warning.host-permission.short.message: Access to all sites is missing.

welcome.begin.message: Set up in about a minute

welcome.details.friction.message: What should happen when you open them?

welcome.details.limit.intro.message: The sites are allowed up to this amount each day.

welcome.details.schedule.message: When do you want to focus?

welcome.details.schedule.intro.message: Pick the hours that matter. You can add more later.

welcome.goal.block.desc.message: For sites you never want to see.

welcome.goal.friction.message: Stop opening sites out of habit

welcome.goal.friction.desc.message: A moment of friction before you go in: often enough to break the habit.

welcome.goal.intro.message: Pick one. Starting with a single change makes it easier to keep.

welcome.goal.limit.message: Spend less time on some sites

welcome.goal.limit.desc.message: Allowed up to a daily amount, then what you choose happens.

welcome.goal.schedule.desc.message: For example no social media on weekdays from 9 to 5.

welcome.goal.title.message: What would you like to change first?

welcome.goal.track.message: Just see where my time goes

welcome.goal.track.desc.message: Nothing is restricted; you can add rules later.

welcome.lead.message: A gentle handbrake for the sites that pull you in.

welcome.level.soft.message: Loosening a rule asks for a confirmation.

welcome.level.strict.message: Loosening a rule waits {hours} h, then needs a typed confirmation.

welcome.note.message: Why does this matter to you?

welcome.noteHelp.message: Optional. You will see it on the page that stops you: a personal reason helps.

welcome.perm.body.message: To slow down the sites you chose, WebHandbrake needs to act on them. It reads nothing else and sends nothing anywhere.

welcome.perm.title.message: One more thing: access to websites

welcome.pin.firefox.message: Click the extensions button (puzzle) in the toolbar, then the gear next to WebHandbrake and “Pin to toolbar”.

welcome.pin.why.message: One tap to see the status of a site, take a break or start a focus session.

welcome.previewEmpty.message: Pick an option to see what it looks like.

wizard.then.remind.message: WebHandbrake shows a short reminder of your reason.
